title: Entra decides who. The catalog decides a manager's scope.
subtitle: Admin > Viewer > Manager. A manager-only session is scoped by the manager groups in its token, not by a unit id supplied by the browser. Developers without a console role are refused.

groups.title: Consent-free browser sign-in · a person's token only

nodes.title: Assigned application groups
lines: [[groups]] = [[application]]
Only assigned application groups are emitted.
Delegated scope: [[scope]]
No role: refuse before account creation.

nodes.title: Resolve scope on each request
lines: Unit / team: [[manager-group]]
[[resolve]] checks token groups.
No Graph call or directory grant.

nodes.title: 1 · Azure CLI token
lines: az login in the customer tenant
[[open]]
The pre-authorized CLI requests Turnstile's API scope.
Token stays out of the URL and files.

nodes.title: 2 · Exchange for a short code
lines: [[exchange]]
Verify tenant, roles and delegated caller.
[[ttl]]
Store a hash; the code can be redeemed once.

nodes.title: 3 · Open the console and redeem
lines: The link carries [[login-code]]; the console calls [[redeem]].
Consume the code and issue an HttpOnly session cookie; remove the code from the address.
Expired or replayed code: 401. A workload token cannot open a person's browser session.
The session keeps the groups captured at sign-in; sign in again after membership changes.

nodes.title: [[admin]]
lines: Owner; full console administration
Controls unit budgets, catalog, tiers, enforcement modes and Apply now.
An Admin role takes precedence even if Manager is also present.

nodes.title: [[viewer]]
lines: Member; reads all scopes
No owner-governed writes
Viewer + Manager is an unrestricted reader, not a scoped manager.
Reporting workloads may hold Viewer.

nodes.title: [[manager]]
lines: Member; scoped units, teams and people
Unit manager: its teams' budgets and people.
Team manager: its people's budgets; parent is context only.
Missing or overage groups grant no managed scope.

nodes.title: Scope is enforced on API routes and object ids; hiding controls in the browser is not the boundary.

notice: The standard Microsoft sign-in button still needs the tenant's one-time consent. This CLI handoff avoids that web-consent dependency; it does not bypass Entra assignment, tenant validation or server-side authorization. Fork evidence is pinned to c0c345a.
